newsitem.title: UK: London Japanese stocks fall as yen hits blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: London Japanese stocks fall as yen hits blue-chips.

text.p: Japanese shares traded here were sharply weaker as the yen strengthened against the dollar, sparking widespread selling in exporters' shares, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 fell to 1,572.3, 4.5 points lower by 1345 GMT, they said. The yen traded at 116.20 against the dollar.
"At one point this morning the yen broke through 115 and that's a crucial level for most exporters," said one dealer.
Blue-chip NEC fell 10 yen to 1,580 yen and among the auto stocks, Mitsubishi fell 2.5 yen to 902.5 yen.
Dealers said NTT, mostly immune from currency considerations, firmed.
